answer:
The first Prime Minister of the Russian Empire was **Count Sergei Witte** (also known as Sergey Yulyevich Witte), who came into office on **October 19, 1905**. He took up the newly created position of Chairman of the Committee of Ministers on November 1, 1905.

Witte served under Emperor Nicholas II and resigned on April 22, 1906. His tenure followed the 1905 Revolution, during which he played a crucial role in drafting the October Manifesto that established the State Duma and moved Russia toward constitutional monarchy.
